_note: ⛔ SNG-391. AUTHORED water — which locations bear inland water, and WHY, read from each description. This replaced a REGEX over prose that had a 10-of-18 false-positive rate: it matched 'the Lattice-folk are WELL-served', 'a very WELL-kept ledger', the place name 'the Crossing', and — worst — two NEGATIONS: 'NO river-plot reaches here' and 'NOTHING here is about the river'. ⚠️ DO NOT REINTRODUCE PROSE REGEX. A regex over prose finds words, not facts.
_use: The pipeline digs a shallow basin at each `authored` location before flow routing, then places the stated water kind. `dropped` records what the regex wrongly matched and must NOT be re-added.
_submerged: ⛔ `sunken_choir` is the ONLY location authored as standing IN water — 'a pre-Transition amphitheatre, flooded'. Every other water-bearing settlement stands on the SHORE; the pipeline pushes the shoreline back from them. The lake-containment gate asserts exactly this.

echo_river_crossing.why: the old stone-and-cable bridge where the Echo River narrows

millbrook.why: a RIVERSIDE farming village; water wheels turn along the Echo River

archive_hollow.why: a collapsed limestone sink UPSTREAM of the crossing, opened by spring floods

sunken_choir.why: a pre-Transition amphitheatre, flooded — the name is the fact

greywater_stilts.why: a town built ON STILTS over the southern marsh

the_quiet_ground.why: still grey water, wide windows — the water is what the dying look at

waystone.why: bridge-builders and road-walkers; THE MASONS BUILD THE CROSSING — a bridge needs a river

the_hollowing.why: the seam between drained wood and tended ground

thinwater.why: the water runs thin here and so does everything else

dropped.tier_seven: 'the Lattice-folk are WELL-SERVED' — an adverb, not a well
dropped.the_scour: 'ending a thing WELL is a craft'
dropped.greyhearth: 'the CROSSING's dead' — the place name, not a ford
dropped.the_axis_gate: 'twelve roads leave the CROSSING' — the place name
dropped.the_crossing: 'every axis CROSSES here' — it is a road crossing, not a river one
dropped.the_low_market: 'near enough the CROSSING to be respectable'
dropped.kestrels_roost: ⛔ NEGATED: 'nothing here is about the river'
dropped.the_harborward: a sea harbour — already coastal, needs no inland water
dropped.the_unlit_deep: 'past the harbor' — sea, and it is a cavern
